verdict.rationale: The evidence shows replica-skill ships its own SKILL.md files that users install, paste into a chat, or copy into `.claude/skills/`. Nothing documents a template or guide for authoring a new skill with name and description frontmatter. Installing or reusing existing skills is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for authoring from a documented template.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author a new skill from a documented template — a SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter — without reverse-engineering existing skills
